# cato_bulk_rpf_move_rule (Resource)

The `cato_bulk_rpf_move_rule` resource orders Remote Port Forwarding sections and rules and publishes the policy revision. Sections are ordered by `section_index`; rules by `index_in_section` within their `section_name`. This resource is not importable; it is created on the first apply.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `rule_data` (Attributes Map) Map of rule name to its ordering data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule_data))
- `section_data` (Attributes Map) Map of section name to its ordering data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--section_data))

<a id="nestedatt--rule_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_data`

Required:

- `index_in_section` (Number) 1-based position of the rule within its section.
- `section_name` (String) Name of the section the rule is ordered within.


<a id="nestedatt--section_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `section_data`

Required:

- `section_index` (Number) 1-based position of the section in the policy.
